description: OLE-UPDATE failures on a read/write copy through a server keyset optimistic Recordset of 'SELECT ID, Code, L, Txt FROM Items': for each attempt the edit, then Update, EditMode, Status, the Connection Errors, CancelUpdate and EditMode. Attempts: L = "abc"; L = 3,000,000,000; a 60-character Txt; on row 2 Code = 'a1' (unique conflict); Code of 16 characters; AddNew with Code 'a1'; Delete of row 1 referenced by Child; on Req: AddNew with the required column unset, with V = -1 against the CHECK constraint, with a duplicate key and with a 8-character R. Finally the stored rows are read. Asks where each failure surfaces, the per-record status and what reaches the file.
retentionNote: Designed r-oledb-odbc probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
